This '''clone trooper sergeant''' served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], this [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|clone trooper sergeant]] took part in a [[Mission to Malastare (Clone Wars)|mission]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]].<ref name="Dug Out" />
